classes.title: Listen and sway
classes.goal: Hear the whole song and move to the beat
classes.parentTip: Sit together at the piano. Sway side to side while the song plays.

segments.caption: Stretch up tall!
segments.parentCue: Stretch arms up, then hands back

classes.title: Find the beat
classes.goal: Tap a steady beat while the grown-up plays the tune
classes.parentTip: Any key is fine. Tap with your child's hand at first, then let go.

segments.caption: Tap any key on the beat
segments.parentCue: You play the tune, your child taps the beat

segments.caption: Tap, tap, tap, like a heartbeat
Can you do it once more?

classes.title: Bear low, bird high
classes.goal: Hear the difference between low and high sounds
classes.parentTip: Low keys are on the left, high keys on the right. Any key on the correct side counts.

segments.caption: Low keys sound like a big bear
segments.parentCue: Show the low end of the piano

segments.caption: High keys sound like a little bird
segments.parentCue: Show the high end of the piano

segments.caption: Is it the bear or the bird?
Is it the bear or the bird?
Is it the bear or the bird?
Is it the bear or the bird?

classes.title: Loud and soft
classes.goal: Tap the beat loudly, then softly
classes.parentTip: Loud means strong, not banging. Whisper when it's time to play soft.

segments.caption: Let's play loud and soft
segments.parentCue: Show a big tap and a tiny tap

segments.caption: Loud like a drum, soft like a whisper
Now loud for the whole song
Now loud for the whole song
Now loud for the whole song

classes.title: Slow and fast
classes.goal: Follow the music when it goes slow and fast
classes.parentTip: Let the tempo lead your child. Slow down if taps get wild, then try fast again.

segments.caption: Songs can go slow or fast
segments.parentCue: Move your arms slowly, then quickly

segments.caption: Slow like a turtle, fast like a bunny
segments.parentCue: Walk your fingers slowly, then fast

segments.caption: Stretch up tall!
segments.parentCue: Stretch arms up, then hands back

classes.title: Stop and go
classes.goal: Tap when the music plays and freeze when it stops
classes.parentTip: Make freezing silly and fun. Holding still is a big skill for little ones.

segments.caption: When the music stops, we freeze!
Go means tap, stop means freeze

classes.title: Play together
classes.goal: Play the song together, grown-up on the tune, child on the beat
classes.parentTip: Follow your child's lead. If they stop to listen, keep playing and smile.

segments.caption: Let's play together
segments.parentCue: You play the tune, your child taps along

segments.caption: Sing, tap and smile
segments.parentCue: Sing the words while you play

segments.caption: Play it together
segments.parentCue: Your child taps any key on the beat

segments.caption: One more time
segments.parentCue: Swap: let your child choose loud or soft

segments.caption: Again, nice and easy
segments.parentCue: Swap: let your child choose loud or soft

segments.caption: Let's do it again
segments.parentCue: Swap: let your child choose loud or soft

segments.caption: And again!
segments.parentCue: Swap: let your child choose loud or soft

segments.caption: One more time
segments.parentCue: Swap: let your child choose loud or soft

segments.caption: Again, nice and easy
segments.parentCue: Swap: let your child choose loud or soft

segments.caption: Let's do it again
segments.parentCue: Swap: let your child choose loud or soft

classes.title: Concert time
classes.goal: Play the whole song from start to end and celebrate
classes.parentTip: Clap, cheer and bow together. Mistakes are fine. The fun is playing to someone.

segments.caption: Take a bow, then hands ready
segments.parentCue: Bow together, then sit at the piano

segments.caption: Play the whole song!
segments.parentCue: You play the tune, your child taps the beat

segments.caption: Encore!
segments.parentCue: You play the tune, your child taps the beat
